proof: Each small cube is uniformly either white or black. Read each visible face cell, identify repeated face appearances of the same boundary cube, and compare the two views over all24 proper cube rotations. Exactly one orientation is compatible with both colors. Its forced white union has18 distinct cubes; the remaining9 can all be black, including every free unseen cell. Thus upper bound9 is attained.
source_semantic_warning: Outlining an entire white cell is not allowed to fill it or add a third kind. Adding any dark dot at a grid corner can be read as another vertex; not an acceptable counting mark.
